sinopsis.es: Moon recoge una tortuga en la carretera. Instantes antes ha logrado esquivarla mientras conducía, saliendo completamente ilesa de un accidente que nos introduce en este —quizá utópico— mundo sin adultos.
sinopsis.en: Moon picks up a turtle from the road. Moments before, she had swerved to avoid it while driving, emerging completely unscathed from an accident that introduces us to this — perhaps utopian — world without adults.
